limitations: Studio UI snapshot includes visible rows, not necessarily every post.
Retention graphs, swipe decisions, traffic sources, and share counts require their dedicated Studio analytics views.

findings.summary: 10 supplied posts have view counts; their median is 35.5. This is an internal comparison only, not an algorithm benchmark.
recommended_action: Compare each post to this account's own baseline using the same post-age window.

findings.summary: Among the 3 highest-viewed supplied videos, average percentage viewed ranges from 17.1% to 78%. This identifies a test opportunity, not a proven causal format difference.
recommended_action: Use the higher-retention video (Toys Sameto / Clean Up Song! 🧸🧹 Good Habits for Kids | CoComelon Hindi #TheNaughtyDuo #shorts) as one reference; test its hook/pacing against a new original idea.
Review the early drop-off on the lower-retention video (Kaartik & Kaavya Ki Pyari Adatein! 🌟 Hindi Cartoons & Rhymes Collection | #TheNaughtyDuo) in per-video retention graphs.

findings.summary: Shorts feed exposure and viewed-vs-swiped data are missing, so distribution versus creative performance cannot be separated.
recommended_action: Add shown-in-feed and viewed-vs-swiped metrics from YouTube Studio.

findings.summary: The latest Studio card is only First 3 hours 15 minutes old; its early view count is not a reliable performance diagnosis yet.
recommended_action: Recheck after at least 24-48 hours and compare with videos at the same age.

findings.summary: YouTube Studio currently reports views last 28 days: 4700, watch hours last 28 days: 13.8, subscribers gained net last 28 days: 10, current subscribers: 10. These are channel-level totals, not proof of which video factor caused reach.
recommended_action: Use per-Short feed exposure and retention data to diagnose individual videos.

findings.summary: The three highest-viewed supplied videos account for about 81% of YouTube Studio's 28-day channel views. Studio's displayed channel total is rounded, so this share is approximate.
recommended_action: Study what differs in the top videos, then test one original hook/pacing variation at a time rather than repeating titles or scenes.

findings.summary: 6 supplied posts have view counts; their median is 170. This is an internal comparison only, not an algorithm benchmark.
recommended_action: Compare each post to this account's own baseline using the same post-age window.

findings.summary: The supplied TikTok posts do not include all diagnostic fields: average_watch_time_seconds, full_video_watch_rate, shares.
recommended_action: Add average watch time, full-video watch rate, and shares before attributing low reach to a particular cause.

findings.summary: Among supplied captions, 1 generic reach hashtag and 0 captions with 8+ hashtags were found. This is a metadata quality issue, not proof of suppression.
recommended_action: Replace broad tag piles with a few accurate topic, language, and audience phrases; do not promise that hashtags alone increase reach.

findings.summary: TikTok Studio displays 100 posts. This confirms account activity, not current reach or monetization eligibility.
recommended_action: Review the latest post-level watch time, completion, shares, and traffic-source metrics.

findings.summary: The current Studio snapshot shows 4 posts within about 13 minutes. That pacing is observable; any effect on distribution is unproven.
recommended_action: Test a more spaced schedule on the next comparable batch and compare equal-age metrics; do not delete or repost these videos.

findings.summary: The local log contains 1 repeated YOUTUBE title group(s); this does not prove multiple public posts because the log can include drafts, retries, or privacy changes.
recommended_action: Cross-check platform video IDs and visibility in official Studio before deleting, privating, or re-uploading anything.

findings.summary: The newest timestamp in the local upload log is 2026-10-02; it is older than 3 days.
recommended_action: Verify recent live uploads in each platform's Studio; local logs are not authoritative publication records.

safe_fixes_applied.detail: The Studio scraper now falls back to role-based rows when table rows are absent and extracts visible data rows from the pinned Brave session.
Platform adapters now report analytics as unavailable instead of inventing zero views and likes.
The configured YouTube channel ID was corrected to the ID linked from the signed-in The Naughty Duo Studio dashboard.
The doctor labels missing evidence explicitly and does not present static targets as measured performance.

next_experiment.rule: Change one variable at a time and compare against the channel's own recent baseline.
next_experiment.youtube: Test first-second hook clarity while holding topic, duration, and posting window as constant as practical.
next_experiment.tiktok: Test searchable on-screen/caption phrasing and a visible payoff; compare average watch time, full-video watch rate, and shares.
next_experiment.approval_boundary: Drafts and local reports only; no live metadata edits, deletes, uploads, paid promotion, or account changes.
